item.title: SpaceXAI 的 Grok Bot 将智能体变为可操控应用的持久化数字同事，月费 120 美元
item.summary: SpaceXAI, the division of SpaceX formerly known as xAI, is launching an early beta version of Grok Bot, a new agent designed to move AI assistants beyond answering prompts and toward continuously executing work across the software employees already use.
